name: smartwatch-v1-stm32
description: Standalone STM32L432 smartwatch PCB implemented in tscircuit

scripts.build:routed: SMARTWATCH_ROUTED=1 npm run build -- --autorouter-timeout 5m && node scripts/check-connectivity.mjs --require-routing
scripts.snapshot:update: npm run build:routed && SMARTWATCH_ROUTED=1 tsci snapshot SMARTWATCH_V1_STM32.circuit.tsx --update --3d --disable-parts-engine
